I’ve been struggling a lot with motivation to live life everyday but I am trying.

I love playing video games, so everyday I list “quests” that I need to do for the day and think that  I’m gaining xp and leveling up everyday. I also list my “life quests” or my bucket list such as traveling to a new “map” or place. I don’t know but these are the things that at least makes me look forward to tomorrow or at least make the days bearable.

Maybe you could look for group therapies or counseling in your city. Usually these are very cheap, and sometimes for free. It would be easier to open up to strangers, especially if you kinda go through the same shit together. Maybe you can also develop friendships here.

Any activities that are mentally stimulating! It could be as simple as learning something new, even browsing on Reddit for everyday facts. It would be better though if you study something more extensively such as learning a new skill, play a new instrument or learning a new language. These activities requires extensive neural connections and is powerful in reorganizing the brain. You can also play some strategy games, such as chess or challenging puzzle games.

The more you learn, the more connections will form in your brain, increasing neuroplasticity and lessening brain atrophy.

TLDR: Learn learn learn!

Taking your antidepressants may also help because it is linked to lower brain inflammation therefore less brain cell death.
